stem: What is the most likely reason Nelson asks Lucia this question?
instruction:
Read line 25.

NELSON: Hi, Lucia. Where'd you get that book?

options.label: A
options.text: To learn where he can buy the same book

options.label: B
options.text: To find out if she picked up his book in the library

options.label: C
options.text: To get suggestions from her about where to look for his book

options.label: D
options.text: To see if there is another copy of the book in the library

visual_elements: NELSON: Hi, Lucia. Where'd you get that book?
